items.summary: Recommendation: decline the aliencouncil.com affiliate prototype this cycle and prioritize measurement and execution backlog clearance. The available evidence shows 28 sessions, 10 affiliate clicks, and 0 attributed orders; the available Amazon window is only 2026-09-21, with $0 site-attributed commission and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned to a site. The site incurred $16.92 of AI cost during 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26, implying an AI-only proxy margin of -$16.92, not a contribution margin because infrastructure, domain, labor, and other costs are unavailable and the periods do not align. Fleet AI spend was $943.09 for 2026-09-01 through 2026-09-26 against only $4.92 of aggregate commission reported for 2026-09-21; this is not a valid ROI or margin calculation. The 190 impressions and position 4.3 for /brief/2026-08-14 are reach metrics, not revenue evidence. Do not claim revenue lift, ROI, incrementality, or a supported forecast. Minimum measurement before reconsideration: a matched 14-day or 100-new-impression test window with site/page-level affiliate clicks, ordered items, shipped items, commission, AI cost, attributable infrastructure cost, and aligned timestamps; retain unknowns where unavailable. Existing backlog remains material: 174 approved proposals lack execution requests, 46 failed-request repairs are open, 26 deployed improvements await measurement, and 0 improvements are proven.

Decline the aliencouncil.com prototype this cycle. Available evidence shows 28 sessions, 10 affiliate clicks, and 0 attributed orders. Amazon reports $0 site-attributed commission and $4.92 aggregate commission that cannot be assigned. Do not infer ROI, margin, or causal lift.
